text: {"decision": "reject", "reason": "cards.edhrecRank is a popularity ranking (1–20900) for Commander format, not a reference, and its full containment in legalities.id is coincidental since the surrogate primary key spans all integers 1–427907, so any small rank value trivially matches; the two columns denote entirely different things (a rank vs. a row identifier for format-legality records keyed by card uuid)."}
